Questions

Which WageGrid metro has the highest Registered nurses annual median?

Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA has the highest published OEWS May 2025 annual median for Registered Nurses ($128,260). Among metros with a published median: Seattle $128,260, Chicago $100,490, Austin $97,890. WageGrid does not rank suppressed cells or invent a missing wage.

Which WageGrid metro employs the most Registered nurses?

Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN has the highest published OEWS May 2025 employment for Registered Nurses (100,240 wage-and-salary workers). Published employment: Chicago 100,240, Seattle 39,900, Austin 18,920. Self-employed workers are excluded.

Where are Registered nurses most concentrated relative to the national mix?

Chicago has the highest published location quotient (1.02). Published LQs: Chicago 1.02, Seattle 0.88, Austin 0.67.

What is the hourly median for Registered nurses in each metro?

OEWS May 2025 hourly medians: Austin $47.06; Chicago $48.31; Seattle $61.66. Blank means BLS withheld the estimate.

Does this comparison include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS covers wage-and-salary workers and excludes the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment estimate.

U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. WageGrid is not affiliated with BLS. Blank cells are BLS suppressions, not estimates.
